description: Türkiye'deki elektrik santralleri — power plants from the WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0 (snapshot June 2021; staleness caveat: plants commissioned after 2021 absent). Fields: fuel type, capacity (MW), coordinates, commissioning year, owner, per-record source. Caveat: plant and owner names are ASCII/English as published by WRI; native-script names not in source. Generation time-series columns from the source were not extracted (out of scope).
